question: Express 0.03overline{7} in the form of (p)/(q), where p is a whole number and q is a natural number.
solution:
**Given:**

Expression = 0.03overline{7} 

⇒ 0.0377777........

**Calculation:**

Let 0.0377777........ = x (1)

By multiplying (1) by 100

⇒ 3.7777...... = 100x (2) 

By multiplying (1) by 1000 

⇒ 37.7777........ = 1000x (3)

By (3) - (2) 

⇒ 37.7777........ - 3.7777...... = 1000x - 100x 

⇒ 34 = 900x 

⇒ x = 34/900 

⇒ x = 17/450 

**∴ 0.03overline{7} or 0.037777......in the form of p/q is 17/450.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Step 1: Number of 9 in denominator = Number of bars [0.7̅ = 7/9]

Step 2: Number of non bar digit = Number of zeros [0.86̅ = (86 - 8)/90 = 78/90 = 13/10]

Step 3: Subtract the non-bar number from the original number

0.037̅ = (37 - 3)/900

⇒ 34/900 

⇒ 17/450

**∴ The required form of p/q is 17/450.**
